stories.title: AMD Rallies on Expanded Meta AI Deal, Chip Sector Gains
stories.summary: AMD shares rallied after news of an expanded AI infrastructure deal with Meta. The move came alongside a broader rally across chip stocks. Investing.com reported the gains on Monday.
stories.whyItMatters: Deal flow between chipmakers and major AI buyers like Meta signals ongoing strength in AI infrastructure spending, a key driver of chip valuations.
whatToWatch: More detail on the scope and terms of the expanded Meta deal
Whether the broader chip rally holds in coming sessions
questions: What are the financial terms of the expanded Meta deal?
Is the sector-wide chip rally tied to this news or other catalysts?

stories.title: Bladex Posts Record $15B Commercial Portfolio in Q3
stories.summary: Bladex's third-quarter 2026 earnings slides show its commercial portfolio reached a record $15 billion. The bank disclosed the figure in its investor presentation.
stories.whyItMatters: Growth in Bladex's loan book points to continued trade-finance demand across Latin America, a region closely watched by emerging-market investors.
whatToWatch: Full Q3 earnings results and management commentary on growth drivers
questions: What is driving the portfolio growth: new clients or expanded limits?
Does asset quality hold up alongside the growth?

stories.title: Oracle Adds AI-Focused Networking Features and a New Data Platform
stories.summary: Oracle announced new networking features built for AI workloads on its cloud service. It also unveiled an AI data platform with ontology capabilities. Both announcements are part of Oracle's push to expand its AI cloud offerings.
stories.whyItMatters: Oracle's AI infrastructure buildout puts it in direct competition with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud for enterprise AI workloads.
whatToWatch: Rollout timeline and availability of the new networking features
Early customer adoption of the AI data platform
questions: How does the networking offering compare with hyperscaler rivals?
What does the ontology capability add for enterprise customers?

Oracle unveils AI data platform with ontology capabilities

stories.title: Oracle to Add Google TPUs to Its Cloud in 2027
stories.summary: Oracle said it will offer Google's TPU chips on its cloud infrastructure starting in 2027. The move gives Oracle customers a hardware option beyond Nvidia GPUs for AI workloads.
stories.whyItMatters: A multi-vendor chip lineup at a major cloud provider signals growing competition in AI hardware, a trend investors watch for shifts away from Nvidia's dominance.
whatToWatch: Whether other cloud providers add similar multi-chip options
questions: What pricing or performance tradeoffs will TPU instances offer versus GPU instances?
How significant is this deal for Google's TPU business outside its own cloud?

stories.title: JPMorgan: Ex-Banker Rana Pressured Witnesses to Lie in Assault Case
stories.summary: JPMorgan said a former banker, identified as Rana, pushed a sister and a friend to lie in support of a sexual assault case. The available reporting does not give further detail on the case or the court proceeding.
stories.whyItMatters: Legal disputes involving former JPMorgan personnel draw scrutiny to the bank's conduct and legal exposure.
whatToWatch: Further court filings or statements from JPMorgan and the parties involved
questions: What is the full context of the case, and what role did JPMorgan play?
Has Rana responded to the allegation?

stories.title: Oracle Partners With OpenAI on Enterprise AI, Launches Security Mesh
stories.summary: Oracle announced a partnership with OpenAI for enterprise AI integration. It also launched an AI security mesh powered by OpenAI models. Both moves add to a broader set of AI-focused updates Oracle disclosed the same day.
stories.whyItMatters: Deeper OpenAI ties strengthen Oracle's position in the enterprise AI race, where Microsoft already holds a major OpenAI partnership.
whatToWatch: Rollout details for the enterprise AI integration
Which enterprise customers adopt the security mesh first
questions: How does this partnership differ from Microsoft's existing OpenAI relationship?
What does the AI security mesh protect against in practice?

stories.title: Oracle to Offer Snowflake as a Native Cloud Service
stories.summary: Oracle said it will offer Snowflake as a native service on its cloud infrastructure. The announcement is part of a wider set of Oracle cloud and AI updates disclosed the same day.
stories.whyItMatters: A native Snowflake integration could widen Oracle Cloud's appeal to data-analytics customers already using Snowflake.
whatToWatch: Availability timeline for the native Snowflake service
questions: Does this signal closer strategic ties between Oracle and Snowflake?
How will pricing compare with running Snowflake elsewhere?
